title: Blessings That Chase You Down
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner delves into the biblical principle of giving and generosity, explaining how it unlocks a cycle of blessing that can transform your life and the lives of those around you. By exploring the story of the good Samaritan and the teaching of Jesus in Luke 6:38, Pastor Zehner reveals the transformative power of living a life of sacrifice and giving, and how it can bring you closer to God's heart. Join us as we discover the secret to a life of abundance and blessing.
